dedupe_keys.name: cmap tour based and supply chain freight model chicago

description: This repository holds working code for the tour-based and supply chain freight model of the Chicago Metropolitan Agency for Planning (CMAP), which represents the full supply chain of specific commodities shipped from supplier to customer. The README states that the model includes an agent-based computational economics extension, and that after annual commodity flows between individual firms are developed in the national supply chain model, a regional tour-based daily truck model simulates the pickup and delivery tours of individual trucks operating in the CMAP region. Coverage: a national supply chain step and the Chicago metropolitan region for truck tours. Format and access: source code in a public repository. Licence and cost: free to view; no licence file was found in the repository on 2026-09-29, so reuse terms are unclear. Caveats: the README is short and calls the code working code, so documentation, input data and calibration are not described. It supports agent-based and network flow studies of urban freight, for example rerouting or capacity loss on the regional network. It relates to the Freight Analysis Framework, the BTS supply chain indicators and the AIS inland waterway trip model in the catalogue.
